beats.label: S1 · Sam tries dating
beats.text: Julia tells Sam autism doesn't rule out dating. He fumbles through disastrous attempts and quietly develops a crush on Julia herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Julia obsession that will detonate the finale and end their therapy relationship going into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Casey and Evan begin
beats.text: Casey is suspended for defending a bullied classmate and meets that student's brother Evan. Newton punishment gets her recruited to elite Clayton Prep.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces both Evan and the Clayton pipeline that will pull Casey away from Sam's school in S2.

beats.label: S1 · Elsa's affair
beats.text: Lonely with Doug distracted by Sam, Elsa drifts into an affair with Nick, a bartender she meets at a dance class. She keeps it secret.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event that will fracture the marriage and reshape every family relationship in S2.

beats.label: S1 · Enter Paige
beats.text: Warned off Julia after breaking into her house, Sam meets Paige, a loud classmate who chose him. They start dating and she pushes it fast.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Paige is Sam's romantic anchor for the rest of the series; her arrival matters more than the individual dates.

beats.label: S1 · The love ultimatum
beats.text: Paige demands Sam decide if he loves her by their family Olive Garden dinner. Instead he tells her he doesn't, then asks Julia to be his girlfriend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames Sam's central emotional confusion between Julia and Paige heading into the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Meltdown and Miles
beats.text: Julia's furious reaction sends Sam into a meltdown on the bus. At the Winter Formal he apologizes to Paige, unsure of his feelings; Julia gets engaged to Miles.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sam ends S1 mid-crisis with Paige and cut off from Julia — the exact state S2 opens on.

beats.label: S1 · Casey exposes Elsa
beats.text: Casey catches Elsa kissing Nick and confronts her mother. She scrawls the affair on Elsa's to-do board, where Doug reads it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment Doug learns, which is the entire engine of S2's family plot.

cliffhanger.text: Doug has just discovered Elsa's affair through a note his own daughter wrote. The family walks into S2 with a secret that has already detonated, and Sam is alone romantically after telling Paige he doesn't love her.
questions: What will Doug do now that he knows about Nick?
Can Sam figure out what he actually feels for Paige?
Will Casey follow through on leaving Sam behind for Clayton Prep?

characters.name: Sam Gardner
characters.line: Eighteen, autistic, obsessed with penguins; just navigated a first relationship with Paige and torched it by declaring love for his ex-therapist Julia.

characters.name: Casey Gardner
characters.line: Sam's fiercely protective younger sister; on a track scholarship to Clayton Prep and dating Evan, whom she loves.

characters.name: Elsa Gardner
characters.line: The mother; carried on an affair with Nick that Casey has now written onto the family to-do board where Doug read it.

characters.name: Doug Gardner
characters.line: Paramedic dad; has just learned of Elsa's affair, silently, at the exact moment the season ends.

characters.name: Paige Hardaway
characters.line: Sam's girlfriend-then-ex; ended things at the Winter Formal but is still emotionally entangled with him.

characters.name: Julia Sasaki
characters.line: Sam's former therapist; ended the professional relationship over his crush and has just gotten engaged to her boyfriend Miles.

characters.name: Evan Chapin
characters.line: Casey's sweet, in-love-with-her boyfriend; unaware of most of the family drama around her.

characters.name: Zahid Raja
characters.line: Sam's Techtropolis coworker and best friend; the source of most of Sam's dating advice, good and bad.

characters.name: Nick
characters.line: The bartender Elsa slept with; the affair is over, but he is now a live grenade in the Gardner marriage.

beats.label: S2 · Doug walks out
beats.text: Doug punches a wall and moves out to his father's. Sam is untethered — Julia can no longer be his therapist now that he loves her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the family fracture and Sam's therapist vacuum, both of which drive the whole season.

beats.label: S2 · Roommate marriage
beats.text: Doug returns but insists he and Elsa live as roommates. Casey turns cold on her mother; Sam violently rejects her attempts at normalcy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Defines the marital limbo that persists all season and shapes every parent-child dynamic.

beats.label: S2 · Casey meets Izzie
beats.text: At Clayton Prep, Casey clashes with Izzie, then bonds hard with her over shared caretaker burdens. Their closeness starts crowding out Evan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real appearance of the person who becomes the center of Casey's arc — the highest-value introduction of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Paige and Bailey
beats.text: Paige learns Sam kept Elsa's affair secret and breaks up with him. Community service throws him together with Bailey, who starts kissing him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sam's romantic life splits in two — the guilt with Paige and the secret with Bailey both bleed into S3.

beats.label: S2 · Denton, not RISD
beats.text: Sam panics and flees his RISD interview. Ms. Whitaker steers him to Denton's scientific illustration program, and he gets in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the college that becomes the entire S3 setting.

beats.label: S2 · Graduation and 'I love you'
beats.text: Sam gives Paige's valedictorian speech when her voice fails, then tells her he thinks he loves her — undoing the finale of S1 in one move.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reboots the Sam–Paige relationship on new terms right before S3, without resolving the Bailey secret.

beats.label: S2 · Doug can't forgive; Casey holds Izzie's hand
beats.text: Doug quietly admits to a peer he cannot get past Elsa's affair. Casey tells Izzie she slept with Evan, and the two girls hold hands.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two threads that will define S3 — the unhealed marriage and the Casey–Izzie shift — both left explicitly open.

cliffhanger.text: Sam heads to Denton with Paige beside him and Bailey in the shadows. Doug still cannot forgive Elsa, and Casey and Izzie hold hands without letting go.
questions: What is actually happening between Casey and Izzie?

characters.name: Sam Gardner
characters.line: About to start Denton for scientific illustration; just told Paige he loves her while still secretly kissing Bailey.

characters.name: Casey Gardner
characters.line: Settled at Clayton, still dating Evan, but holding Izzie's hand at the end of the season and not letting go.

characters.name: Elsa Gardner
characters.line: Living as Doug's roommate in her own house; running a haircut business for autistic kids; still not forgiven.

characters.name: Doug Gardner
characters.line: Home but emotionally absent from Elsa; punched Nick mid-season; has admitted he cannot move past what she did.

characters.name: Paige Hardaway
characters.line: Sam's girlfriend again after his graduation confession; heading to Bowdoin College.

characters.name: Izzie
characters.line: Casey's intense Clayton Prep friend with a chaotic home life; the line between friendship and something else has just visibly crossed.

characters.name: Evan Chapin
characters.line: Still Casey's boyfriend, in love with her, and completely unaware of what happened with Izzie.

characters.name: Zahid Raja
characters.line: Sam's best friend at Techtropolis; opened up about wanting to become a nurse after their arrest.

characters.name: Julia Sasaki
characters.line: Reconciled with Elsa; pregnant, with her fiancé Miles now working in Africa for Doctors Without Borders.

beats.label: S3 · Sam at Denton
beats.text: Sam starts Denton and is overwhelmed by the lack of structure. He finds footing through disability services and a blunt new friend, Sid.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the college environment and Sam's coping supports; Sid becomes his sanity check when Zahid disappears.

beats.label: S3 · Doug and Megan
beats.text: Doug quietly bonds with Megan, whose autistic daughter Amber knows Sam. He hides how much time they spend together; Elsa clocks it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wedge that finishes what Elsa's affair started, and the person Doug nearly leaves the marriage for.

beats.label: S3 · Zahid falls for Gretchen
beats.text: Zahid falls hard for Gretchen. Sam catches her shoplifting and turns her in, getting her banned; Zahid ends the friendship over it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rupture that isolates Sam for most of the back half and forces both boys to grow up separately.

beats.label: S3 · Casey kisses Izzie
beats.text: Izzie finds Casey running at night and they kiss. Days later Sam and Paige finally sleep together; Casey confesses the kiss to Evan and breaks up with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment Casey's arc pivots — she chooses Izzie and ends the relationship that has defined her since S1.

beats.label: S3 · Elsa asks for separation
beats.text: Doug takes Megan to a Fleetwood Mac concert; Elsa asks to separate. On a New York work trip Doug and Megan kiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The marriage moves from wounded to actively ending — the emotional low point that S3 needs to reverse in its final hour.

beats.label: S3 · Weddings, crashes, reunions
beats.text: Gretchen dumps Zahid at their elopement; Sam saves him and they reconcile. Elsa races to stop Doug and crashes into his car; they kiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The chaotic pileup that resets three relationships at once — the exact shape the family carries into S4.

beats.label: S3 · UCLA and a new life
beats.text: Casey commits to chasing UCLA while dating Izzie openly. Sam and Zahid decide to be roommates; Paige takes a nanny job — for Julia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every character walks into S4 with a decision made in this beat. This is the launchpad.

cliffhanger.text: Doug is wearing his wedding ring again and Sam is moving in with Zahid. Casey has claimed Izzie and UCLA in the same breath, while Paige lands unexpectedly inside Julia's life as her nanny.
questions: Can Doug really forgive Elsa this time, or is Megan unfinished?
Will Sam and Zahid actually survive living together?
Can Casey hold onto Izzie and UCLA at once?

characters.name: Sam Gardner
characters.line: A Denton freshman coping through disability services; reconciled with Zahid and about to move in with him; back together with Paige.

characters.name: Casey Gardner
characters.line: Out with Izzie, broken up with Evan, and telling her coach she is going hard for UCLA.

characters.name: Izzie
characters.line: Casey's now-official girlfriend, publicly claimed after a season of hiding and jealousy.

characters.name: Elsa Gardner
characters.line: Just crashed into Doug's car to stop him leaving with Megan; the marriage is tentatively back on.

characters.name: Doug Gardner
characters.line: Kissed Megan in New York but chose Elsa; wearing his wedding ring again.

characters.name: Zahid Raja
characters.line: Left at the altar by Gretchen; back with Sam and about to be his roommate; still training as a nurse.

characters.name: Paige Hardaway
characters.line: Back with Sam after a college washout; has just taken a job as Julia's nanny.

characters.name: Evan Chapin
characters.line: Broken up with Casey after her confession; helped by Doug toward becoming an EMT.

characters.name: Megan
characters.line: The autism-parent friend Doug almost left Elsa for; the kiss in New York happened, and Elsa now knows about the closeness.

beats.label: S4 · Roommates, and a confession
beats.text: Sam moves in with Zahid. Doug admits to Elsa that he kissed Megan in New York, poisoning their fragile reconciliation from the start.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both major domestic setups for the season — Sam's independence and the shaky marriage — are established in the opening.

beats.label: S4 · Antarctica takes shape
beats.text: Techtropolis shuts down. Sam fixates on getting himself to Antarctica and starts training his body — and everyone around him — for the cold.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The engine of the entire final season; every other Sam thread is measured against it.

beats.label: S4 · Casey breaks
beats.text: Buckling under Clayton's demands, Casey freezes at a UCLA-scouted meet and walks off the track mid-race. It scares her and her family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The collapse that resets Casey's UCLA path and her relationship with Izzie.

beats.label: S4 · Zahid's cancer
beats.text: Zahid is diagnosed with treatable testicular cancer. Gretchen briefly reappears in his life before he sees her clearly and lets her go.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Raises the stakes on Sam's Antarctica plan, since Sam has promised to drive Zahid home from surgery.

beats.label: S4 · Casey back to Newton
beats.text: Casey quits track, transfers back to Newton, and nearly loses Izzie to the strain before they reconcile and reset their relationship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Casey and Izzie back on stable ground and pointed jointly at UCLA — the arc's landing.

beats.label: S4 · Program cancelled
beats.text: Denton cancels its Antarctica program. Devastated, Sam throws out every penguin, then returns to the aquarium and decides to go on his own.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The choice that turns Sam's dream from an institutional trip into an act of real independence.

beats.label: S4 · Sam steps onto the ice
beats.text: Sam pauses things with Paige and walks out the door onto Antarctica — with Doug beside him, having asked to come along.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The series' closing image and Doug's most decisive gesture as a father.

cliffhanger.text: The show closes with Sam standing on Antarctic ice and Doug at his shoulder. Casey and Izzie have promised each other that whoever gets into UCLA has to go; Zahid is out of surgery and healing; Elsa and Doug have patched things together one more time.
questions: Will Sam thrive on the ice or hit his limits?
Can Casey and Izzie both actually make it to UCLA?
Have Doug and Elsa's marriage finally healed for real?

characters.name: Sam Gardner
characters.line: Has just stepped onto Antarctica with Doug; paused things with Paige until he's back.

characters.name: Casey Gardner
characters.line: Back at Newton, dating Izzie openly, pushing hard for UCLA with her.

characters.name: Doug Gardner
characters.line: Confessed the Megan kiss, patched the marriage again, and volunteered himself onto the Antarctica trip.

characters.name: Elsa Gardner
characters.line: Absorbed Doug's confession and rebuilt with him; back on solid ground with the family.

characters.name: Zahid Raja
characters.line: Post-surgery for testicular cancer and mending; Sam's roommate and best friend again.

characters.name: Izzie
characters.line: Casey's serious girlfriend; nearly broke up over Casey's stress but re-committed, and now aiming at UCLA too.

characters.name: Paige Hardaway
characters.line: Quit her potato-mascot job and paused her relationship with Sam for the length of his trip.

characters.name: Evan Chapin
characters.line: Doug's EMT trainee; had a final calm conversation with Casey that closed the door on their relationship.
